title: Anti-automation (frontend, backend and Google reCAPTCHA v2)
description: The frontend obtains a token; the backend always verifies it before anything is stored (SR-01). The frontend check alone is never enough.

frontend.production: loads https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?render=explicit and renders the v2 checkbox with captchaSiteKey from GET /api/form-config (AR-07: the site key is the frontend's only key and comes from configuration)
frontend.testMode: when captchaTestMode is true, a checkbox 'I am not a robot (test mode)' yields the token 'test-pass'; no request to Google

testMode.rule: the token 'test-pass' is accepted, every other token is rejected; no network call

production.rule: accepted only when the response is HTTP 200 with success = true; any other status, body or I/O error counts as rejected

backend.rejectedToken: HTTP 400, field captchaToken; nothing stored, no email (AC-001-07, AC-002-06)
backend.startupGuard: the backend refuses to start when CAPTCHA_TEST_MODE=true outside the Spring profiles local and test, or when CAPTCHA_TEST_MODE is false and RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY or RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY is empty (SR-02)
